title: Keshia Thomas
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Keshia Thomas is a member of the Fresno Unified Board of Education in California, representing Trustee Area 1. She assumed office in 2019. Her current term ends on December 11, 2026. Thomas did not run for re-election to Fresno Unified School District Board of Education Trustee Area 1 in 2026.
Thomas ran for election to the Fresno City Council to represent District 3 in California. She was on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
